business_problem: NRI needed to meet rising demand for managed cloud services that satisfied financial governance, digital sovereignty, and data residency requirements while expanding its financial SaaS and enterprise AI offerings for customers in regulated Japanese industries.
solution_summary: NRI expanded from Oracle Dedicated Region Cloud@Customer into Oracle Alloy so it could deliver a sovereign cloud service from its own Tokyo and Osaka data centers while keeping the breadth of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services and financial applications available to customers. Oracle Alloy acts as the service foundation, giving NRI access to more than 100 OCI services inside a dedicated, tightly governed environment that aligns with Japan's financial-sector compliance requirements. NRI combines that platform with its atlax managed service for network, operations, and cybersecurity management, and it is adding OCI AI Infrastructure plus NVIDIA Hopper GPUs to support sovereign generative AI use cases. This architecture lets NRI keep sensitive workloads and AI development inside controlled regional facilities while still exposing customers to modern cloud-native, financial, and AI capabilities.

solution_components.name: Oracle Dedicated Region Cloud@Customer
solution_components.role: Provides the original in-country cloud foundation for NRI's financial SaaS workloads in Tokyo and Osaka.

solution_components.name: Oracle Alloy
solution_components.role: Serves as NRI's sovereign cloud platform for packaging OCI services and applications under NRI's managed offering.

solution_components.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
solution_components.role: Supplies the more than 100 cloud services and financial application services NRI exposes to customers inside its regulated environment.

solution_components.name: OCI AI Infrastructure
solution_components.role: Adds GPU-backed infrastructure for customers exploring generative AI and large language model development under sovereign controls.

data_flow: Financial SaaS workloads and managed cloud services run in NRI's Tokyo and Osaka dedicated cloud environments; Oracle Alloy exposes OCI services and applications to customers; atlax operates and monitors the environment; OCI AI Infrastructure extends the same governed footprint to enterprise AI and large language model projects.
business_outcome: NRI expanded its cloud business with a sovereign AI-ready platform, improved customer satisfaction, and positioned itself to offer regulated customers more than 100 OCI services plus enterprise AI capabilities while keeping workloads inside governed Japanese data centers.
